achievements.name: First Companion
achievements.description: Team up with Helion or Lunara.

steps: At the start of the game, choose either Helion or Lunara as your starter Aniimo.
This unlocks automatically during the tutorial.

achievements.name: Starbound Journey
achievements.description: Earn limited badge: Starbound Journey.

steps: Complete the introductory quests to earn the Starbound Journey badge.
This is a limited-time launch badge — check if still available.

achievements.name: First Step into a New World
achievements.description: Step onto the lands of Idyll.

steps: Complete the tutorial and arrive in the open world of Idyll.
Unlocks automatically during the intro sequence.

achievements.name: Badge Beginnings
achievements.description: Earn your first Collection Badge.

steps: Capture enough Aniimo species in a single region to earn a Collection Badge.
Breezy Plains is the first region — collect several species there.

achievements.name: Echo of the Veins
achievements.description: Activate the Branch in Breezy Plains and receive the ancient blessing.

steps: Find the Branch (a glowing tree structure) in Breezy Plains.
Interact with it to activate and receive the ancient blessing.

achievements.name: Aniilog Beginner
achievements.description: 10 Aniimo recorded in the Index, more friends to connect with.

steps: Capture or encounter 10 unique Aniimo species to record them in your Index.
Explore Breezy Plains thoroughly — plenty of species there.

achievements.name: First Sanctum Foray
achievements.description: Clear the first Sanctum and restore the Vein energy.

steps: Find and enter the first Sanctum dungeon in Breezy Plains.
Defeat all enemies and the boss to clear it and restore Vein energy.

achievements.name: You're Gonna Need a Bigger Aniipod
achievements.description: Obtain your first Alpha Aniimo.

steps: Alpha Aniimo are larger, more powerful variants that spawn in the overworld.
Find and defeat an Alpha Aniimo, then capture it with an Aniipod.
Use higher-quality Aniipods for better capture rates on Alphas.

achievements.name: Healing Hugs
achievements.description: Hug your Aniimo for the first time.

steps: Open the interaction menu with your active Aniimo.
Select the Hug option to embrace your companion.

achievements.name: Alpha Annihilator
achievements.description: Defeat 5 Alpha/Omega Aniimo.

steps: Alpha and Omega Aniimo are boss-tier creatures found in the overworld.
Defeat 5 of them total — cumulative across all encounters.

achievements.name: Home on Wheels
achievements.description: The Homeland is complete, and now you have a place to call your own.

steps: Progress the main story until you unlock your RV/Homeland.
Complete the initial setup quests for your mobile home.

achievements.name: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
achievements.description: Your first Sparkling Aniimo, faintly shimmering.

steps: Sparkling Aniimo are rare shiny variants that appear randomly in the wild.
Explore and encounter wild Aniimo — eventually a Sparkling one will appear.
They have a subtle shimmer/particle effect when they spawn.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Sparkling Aniimo have a low spawn rate. Just keep playing and you'll find one naturally.

achievements.name: Guided by the Light
achievements.description: Illuminate 10 Blooms and converge the beams.

steps: Blooms are glowing flower-like structures scattered across the map.
Interact with 10 of them to illuminate them and converge their beams.

achievements.name: Perfect
achievements.description: 5 Perfect Aniimo. The path ahead is bright.

steps: Perfect Aniimo are those with top-tier stats/IVs.
Capture or breed 5 Aniimo that qualify as 'Perfect' in their stats.

achievements.name: In the Same Frame
achievements.description: Capture a moment with your Aniimo by your side.

steps: Open Photo Mode from the menu.
Take a photo with your active Aniimo visible in the frame.

achievements.name: Prismana Splendor
achievements.description: Your first Prismana Aniimo, brilliantly hued.

steps: Prismana Aniimo are ultra-rare color variants — even rarer than Sparkling.
They can appear randomly in the wild with a distinctive rainbow-like hue.
Keep exploring and encountering Aniimo to find one.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Prismana rates are very low. Some players report finding them more often during Prismana Flow weather events.

achievements.name: Junior Wayfarer
achievements.description: Become a Junior Wayfarer.

steps: Complete enough quests and activities to rank up to Junior Wayfarer.
This is an early progression milestone.

achievements.name: Index Adept
achievements.description: 40 Aniimo recorded in the Index, more companions to find.

steps: Capture or encounter 40 unique Aniimo species.
Explore multiple areas and biomes for new species.

achievements.name: Sparkling Bright
achievements.description: A Sparkling Prismana Aniimo, dazzlingly radiant.

steps: Find an Aniimo that is both Sparkling AND Prismana — the rarest combination.
This is extremely rare and requires luck or extensive play.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the rarest variant type. Just play the game and it will happen eventually — don't specifically grind for it.

achievements.name: Hatching Plans
achievements.description: Witness 10 Eggs hatching.

steps: Collect eggs from breeding or exploration and place them in an incubator.
Hatch 10 eggs total.

achievements.name: Cashflow
achievements.description: 500k Credits slip through your fingers.

steps: Spend 500,000 Credits total (cumulative lifetime spending).
Buy items, upgrades, and equipment to work toward this.

achievements.name: Radiant as a Rainbow
achievements.description: Witness a Prismana Flow.

steps: Prismana Flow is a special weather/world event that occurs periodically.
When it triggers, the sky displays rainbow-like effects and Prismana Aniimo spawn rates increase.
Just play regularly and you'll encounter one.

achievements.name: Rising Challenger
achievements.description: Complete 10 Pathfinder Challenges, steady and sure.

steps: Pathfinder Challenges are combat/exploration tasks available throughout the world.
Complete 10 of them — check the challenge board for available ones.

achievements.name: Carry That Weight
achievements.description: Obtain a Level 10 Carried Item.

steps: Carried Items are equipment that level up with use.
Upgrade any Carried Item to Level 10 through regular use and enhancement.

achievements.name: Windchaser: Bronze
achievements.description: Earn the Bronze Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.

steps: Capture enough unique Aniimo species in Breezy Plains to earn the Bronze badge.
Check the Collection menu to see which species you're missing.

achievements.name: Blessed Flow
achievements.description: Level up the Branch in Breezy Plains to Prismana Radiance.

steps: The Branch in Breezy Plains can be leveled up by feeding it energy.
Collect Vein energy from Sanctums and activities, then level the Branch to Prismana Radiance tier.

achievements.name: Trailblazer of the Plains
achievements.description: Cross every area of Breezy Plains.

steps: Explore and visit every named sub-area within Breezy Plains.
Check the map for undiscovered areas — some may be hidden behind puzzles or traversal.

achievements.name: Alpha Predator
achievements.description: Defeat 20 Alpha/Omega Aniimo.

steps: Defeat 20 Alpha or Omega Aniimo total across all encounters.
These spawn in fixed locations and respawn on a timer.

achievements.name: Windchaser: Silver
achievements.description: Earn the Silver Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.

steps: Capture more unique Aniimo in Breezy Plains to earn the Silver badge.
Some species only appear at specific times of day or weather conditions.

achievements.name: Chest Chaser
achievements.description: Each of the 200 Chests across the world contains a surprise.

steps: Find and open 200 chests scattered across the entire world of Idyll.
Chests are hidden in caves, on cliffs, behind puzzles, and in dungeons.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Use the in-game tracker to see how many chests remain in each area. Some require Twining with specific Aniimo to reach.

achievements.name: Egg-scape Unscathed
achievements.description: Successfully evacuate in Operation: Egg Heist.

steps: Play the Egg Heist PVEVP mode (3-player team).
Complete the mission objectives and evacuate before the timer runs out.

achievements.name: Brilliant Hues
achievements.description: Finish the Breezy Plains lore.

steps: Complete all lore-related quests and discoveries in Breezy Plains.
Talk to NPCs and explore hidden areas for lore fragments.

achievements.name: Dressed for the Part
achievements.description: Fill your wardrobe with 5 outfits. A fresh new look every day.

steps: Acquire 5 different outfits through quests, shops, or events.
Check the wardrobe menu to see your collection.

achievements.name: Windswept Epilogue
achievements.description: Reach the destination of every journey in Breezy Plains.

steps: Complete all Journey quests in Breezy Plains.
Check the quest log for any remaining Journey objectives.

achievements.name: Holo Trainee
achievements.description: Clear any one of the Grass, Water or Fire Holo-Battle Sim.

steps: Access the Holo-Battle Sim from the training facility.
Clear any one elemental simulation (Grass, Water, or Fire).

achievements.name: Rainbow of the Ground
achievements.description: Team up with Irisalis.

steps: Irisalis is a special Aniimo. Find and capture it to team up.
Check guides for Irisalis's spawn location and conditions.

achievements.name: Box of Badges
achievements.description: Collect 20 badges.

steps: Earn 20 total badges from Collection Badges, event badges, and achievement badges.
Focus on completing regional collections for steady badge income.

achievements.name: Trail of the Wind
achievements.description: Complete the Journey quests: Binding Oath, Stars and the Knight, and Warrior.

steps: Complete three specific Journey quest chains in Breezy Plains.
These are story-driven quests with combat and exploration components.

achievements.name: Novice Trailblazer
achievements.description: Become a Novice Trailblazer.

steps: Rank up through the Pathfinder progression to reach Novice Trailblazer.
Complete quests, challenges, and exploration milestones to earn rank XP.

achievements.name: Rising Egg Scout
achievements.description: Reach the Rising Egg Scout rank in Operation: Egg Heist.

steps: Play Operation: Egg Heist regularly and complete objectives.
Earn enough rank points to reach Rising Egg Scout.

achievements.name: Treasured Trade
achievements.description: Complete 1 Aniimo exchange. Both sides get what they wanted.

steps: Find another player and initiate a trade.
Exchange an Aniimo and complete the trade.

achievements.name: Welcome Home
achievements.description: Upgrade RV to Level 8. It's becoming more and more like a proper home.

steps: Collect materials and currency to upgrade your RV.
Upgrade it incrementally until it reaches Level 8.

achievements.name: Aniilog Expert
achievements.description: 80 Aniimo recorded in the Index, every page full of memories.

steps: Record 80 unique Aniimo species in your Index.
Explore all biomes, including time-locked and weather-specific spawns.

achievements.name: A Match Made Through Music
achievements.description: Play the flute and meet with the first Pathfinder.

steps: Obtain the flute item through the main quest.
Play it at the designated location to summon and meet the first Pathfinder NPC.

achievements.name: Sanctum Savant
achievements.description: 10 Sanctums, each full of challenges.

steps: Clear 10 Sanctum dungeons across the world.
Sanctums are scattered across different regions — explore to find them.

achievements.name: Six-Star Supremacy
achievements.description: Ascend an Aniimo to 6 stars for the first time. What an achievement!

steps: Ascending requires duplicate Aniimo and special materials.
Level up and ascend one Aniimo through all star tiers until it reaches 6 stars.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Focus on ascending a common Aniimo first — they're easier to get duplicates for.

achievements.name: Over the Rainbow
achievements.description: 10 Prismana Aniimo. That's a whole squad of rare ones.

steps: Collect 10 Prismana (ultra-rare variant) Aniimo.
Prismana Flows increase their spawn rates — farm during these events.
This requires significant playtime and luck.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Prismana rates are roughly 1/4000. Focus on high-traffic areas during Prismana Flow events.

achievements.name: Aniimo Treasure Team
achievements.description: Your Aniimo go on 5 trips and came back loaded with gifts.

steps: Send your Aniimo on expeditions/treasure trips from your Homeland.
Complete 5 trips — they return automatically after a time.

achievements.name: Wanderer's Might
achievements.description: Level up the Branch in Breezy Plains to Wanderer's Might.

steps: Continue feeding energy to the Branch in Breezy Plains.
Reach the Wanderer's Might tier — the highest Branch level.

achievements.name: Safe and Sound
achievements.description: Evacuate safely in Operation: Egg Heist Team Mode on Nightmare.

steps: Play Operation: Egg Heist on Nightmare difficulty in Team Mode.
Successfully complete the mission and evacuate.
Coordinate with your 3-player team — Nightmare is extremely punishing.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bring your strongest Aniimo and coordinate roles. One player scouts, one fights, one carries eggs.
warnings: Nightmare difficulty is very hard. Dying or failing to evacuate in time will void the achievement for that run.

achievements.name: Challenge Ace
achievements.description: Complete 50 Pathfinder Challenges, forged through perseverance.

steps: Complete 50 Pathfinder Challenges total.
Challenges refresh and new ones unlock as you progress.

achievements.name: Institute Senior
achievements.description: Reach Level 60.

steps: Earn XP through combat, quests, and activities until you reach Level 60.
This requires significant playtime.

achievements.name: Expert Egg Raider
achievements.description: Reach the Expert Egg Raider rank in Operation: Egg Heist.

steps: Play Egg Heist extensively and earn enough rank XP.
Reach the Expert Egg Raider rank through consistent performance.

achievements.name: Supreme Supplier
achievements.description: Fulfill 80 Home orders.

steps: From your Homeland, accept and fulfill supply orders from visitors.
Complete 80 total orders — they refresh periodically.

achievements.name: Aniimology Expert
achievements.description: Upgrade the Breezy Plains Aniilog to Level 9.

steps: The Aniilog levels up as you capture more species and complete activities in Breezy Plains.
Max it out to Level 9 — requires near-complete exploration of the region.

achievements.name: Prismana Hoard
achievements.description: Obtain 5 Prismatic collectibles in Operation: Egg Heist.

steps: During Egg Heist runs, find and collect Prismatic collectibles.
These are rare drops — collect 5 total across multiple runs.

achievements.name: Interlink Star
achievements.description: Get 50 stars in the Holo-Battle Interlink.

steps: The Holo-Battle Interlink is an advanced battle simulation system.
Earn 50 stars by clearing stages with high performance ratings.
Requires strong, well-built Aniimo teams.

achievements.name: A Buddy for My Buddy
achievements.description: Gift 1 Aniimo to a friend in Companion Mode.

steps: Enter Companion Mode with a friend.
Gift them an Aniimo through the gifting interface.

achievements.name: Holo Training Ace
achievements.description: Clear any one of the Grass, Water or Fire Holo-Battle Sim on Hard.

steps: Select Hard difficulty for any elemental Holo-Battle Sim.
Build a team with strong type advantages and clear the simulation.
Requires well-leveled and well-built Aniimo.

achievements.name: Victory Badges
achievements.description: Snatch 6 Victory Badges from Elite Pathfinders.

steps: Elite Pathfinders are powerful trainer NPCs found throughout the world.
Defeat 6 of them in battle to earn their Victory Badges.
These are tough fights requiring optimized Aniimo teams.

achievements.name: Hearts in Tune
achievements.description: Reach Level 5 Bond with a friend.

steps: Play with a friend regularly — co-op activities increase your Bond level.
Reach Bond Level 5 with one friend. Requires sustained co-op play.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bond XP is earned from co-op activities like Egg Heist, exploring together, and trading. Play daily for steady progress.

achievements.name: Windchaser: Gold
achievements.description: Earn the Gold Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.

steps: Capture nearly every Aniimo species available in Breezy Plains.
Some species only appear during specific weather, time of day, or events.
This requires thorough and patient completion of the regional dex.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The Gold badge requires almost 100% of Breezy Plains species. Check the wiki for weather/time-specific spawns you might be missing.

achievements.name: Friends in Focus
achievements.description: Take 1 photo with a friend in the Photo Studio.

steps: Visit the Photo Studio with a friend.
Take a photo together using the studio's tools.

achievements.name: True Colors
achievements.description: Dye your outfit in your own chosen colors, giving it a unique character.

steps: Access the outfit customization/dye menu.
Apply any dye color to your current outfit.
